note: PDT is UTC-7 (cron 14:00). After the fall-back, use 15:00 UTC. Oz cron is UTC.

seeds.coreIdea: You understand a zip by walking it, not by quoting a portal median.
seeds.sourceNote: Brand origin: marketing/91311-market-entry.md; public landscape only.
seeds.bridgeRule: Before you talk number, name the pocket and one trade-off.
seeds.habit: Stand outside one familiar 91311 landmark for two quiet minutes.

seeds.coreIdea: 91311 is at least six markets. A single Chatsworth median hides the decision.
seeds.sourceNote: marketing/91311-social-content-library.md item 5. No invented prices.
seeds.bridgeRule: If someone quotes the Chatsworth median, ask which Chatsworth.
seeds.habit: Write the six pocket names once from memory.

seeds.coreIdea: On land-rich parcels, keeping the first house as a rental is a question worth running before a sign goes up.
seeds.sourceNote: Owner playbook item 11. No rent or return claims.
seeds.bridgeRule: Run three numbers with a human: realistic rent, current payment, what equity would do next. Include the version where selling wins.
seeds.habit: Write one sentence: list, hold, or I do not know yet.

seeds.coreIdea: The rocks were a backlot. The homes are a neighborhood. Buyers should feel the place before the payment.
seeds.sourceNote: Iverson Movie Ranch public history; do not invent production counts in the video if unverified today. Prefer: filmed for generations.
seeds.bridgeRule: Put Garden of the Gods or a public overlook on the showing route before you argue finishes.
seeds.habit: Name one public Chatsworth place you would show before a living room.

seeds.coreIdea: Equestrian in a listing is a marketing word. Horse-keeping is parcel by parcel.
seeds.sourceNote: Social library item 6. Never confirm a specific parcel in the video.
seeds.bridgeRule: Verify horse-keeping rights before anyone pays a premium for the dream.
seeds.habit: If you see equestrian today, write: marketing word or verified right?

seeds.principle: Name the risk; stay in your lane
seeds.coreIdea: Long-held 91311 bases can be fragile at transfer. The video flags the conversation; a CPA or attorney owns the plan.
seeds.sourceNote: family-wealth-preservation / Prop 19 is an escalation topic. No tax advice.
seeds.bridgeRule: If a family says keep it in the family, ask whether they have sat with tax counsel on the transfer — then stop.
seeds.habit: Send yourself the family-wealth page link; do not diagnose anyone’s tax.

seeds.coreIdea: Twenty minutes in the Hill-Palmer cottage teaches more personality than an hour of listing photos.
seeds.sourceNote: Public historic site. Confirm open hours only if dated and sourced; otherwise do not claim today’s hours.
seeds.bridgeRule: Learn the place as a neighbor first.
seeds.habit: Read one paragraph of Chatsworth history without turning it into a pitch.

seeds.coreIdea: Near the corridor you will hear trains. Waving that away is a sale, not a service.
seeds.sourceNote: Social library item 7. No discount percentages.
seeds.bridgeRule: Time one showing so they can hear a train. Decide with ears, not adjectives.
seeds.habit: Practice one sentence that names train noise without apology or hype.

seeds.coreIdea: On a big 91311 lot the back half may be an unbuilt question — not a kitchen remodel by default.
seeds.sourceNote: house-hacking page. No rent, cost, or timeline claims. City/permit questions go to the city and licensed pros.
seeds.bridgeRule: Before you spend on a kitchen you do not need, ask what the land is allowed to do — then verify.
seeds.habit: Write one question for planning/zoning. Do not answer it on camera.

seeds.principle: Culture is the proof of zoning
seeds.coreIdea: Day of the Horse shows what equestrian zoning actually protects: families and practice, not brochure copy.
seeds.sourceNote: Event exists seasonally. Do not announce this year’s date unless verified the morning of.
seeds.bridgeRule: Come once as a neighbor, not a shopper.
seeds.habit: Attend or watch one local thing this week with no business card in your hand.

seeds.coreIdea: Porter Ranch solves polish. Chatsworth often solves land and entitlements you cannot replicate. Neither is always better.
seeds.sourceNote: Social library item 8. No price comparisons.
seeds.bridgeRule: If the wealth plan values optionality on land, start in Chatsworth. If they want turnkey uniformity, say Porter Ranch may win — even if it points away from a sale.
seeds.habit: Say one sentence that could cost you a listing and still be true.

seeds.principle: Paperwork is how land survives a generation
seeds.coreIdea: Probate can force a sale to split proceeds. If the point was keep the land, a trust conversation belongs with counsel — not a reel.
seeds.sourceNote: living-trust-guide. Legal advice is off-limits. Escalate.
seeds.bridgeRule: Point to the conversation guide. Do not draft anyone’s estate plan.
seeds.habit: Open the living-trust guide and note one question for an attorney.

seeds.coreIdea: Locals stop seeing the sandstone change color. Buyers never forget the first time.
seeds.sourceNote: Social library item 16. No premium percentages.
seeds.bridgeRule: Watch golden hour once from a public spot before you explain a foothill ask.
seeds.habit: Catch tonight’s light for sixty seconds without filming first.

seeds.coreIdea: Stale numbers dressed as insight hurt buyers. Structure lasts. This week’s comps are a conversation.
seeds.sourceNote: Social library item 9. Never invent a median, DOM, or rate.
seeds.bridgeRule: Publish structure. Pull this week’s pocket comps in a direct conversation.
seeds.habit: Delete one unsourced number from a draft caption if you find one.

seeds.coreIdea: Owners already hold the scarce thing. They need a pocket-level read, not a portal guess.
seeds.sourceNote: home-value page. One personal reply. No drip implied as a promise of results.
seeds.bridgeRule: Invite the Equity Snapshot. Do not quote a value on camera.
seeds.habit: Send the snapshot link to yourself and walk the form once.

seeds.coreIdea: Horses vs polish, trains vs commute, land vs newer HOA product — say the trade-offs in public.
seeds.sourceNote: Social library item 4.
seeds.bridgeRule: Teach the structure free. Personalized numbers stay in a conversation.
seeds.habit: Share the /91311 page with one person who is not a lead.

seeds.principle: Discount is a tool, not a slur
seeds.coreIdea: Some commuters will trade noise for Metrolink instead of the 118 at 7am. That is a preference, not a moral failure.
seeds.sourceNote: Item 7 continued. No dollar discount claims.
seeds.bridgeRule: Ask whether they commute downtown before you talk them out of the corridor.
seeds.habit: Write the buyer’s actual commute before you write the pocket pitch.

seeds.coreIdea: List vs hold is not a vibe. It is rent, payment, and next-use of equity — run both ways.
seeds.sourceNote: Item 11. Placeholders only. Lender/CPA for financing and tax.
seeds.bridgeRule: Fill three blanks with the client in a private conversation. Never on the reel.
seeds.habit: Draw three blank lines labeled rent, payment, next use.

seeds.coreIdea: 91311 is chapter one. West Hills and the pass to Simi are kin, not a dilution of origin.
seeds.sourceNote: Market entry trilogy. In Chatsworth-targeted posts, origin stays first.
seeds.bridgeRule: Tell Chatsworth first when the audience is Chatsworth.
seeds.habit: Say Chatsworth before you say Valley.

seeds.principle: Polish and land are not substitutes
seeds.coreIdea: Newer polish and foothill land solve different lives. Do not sell one with the language of the other.
seeds.sourceNote: Six-pocket map. No HOA-fee or price claims.
seeds.bridgeRule: Ask whether they are buying land optionality or turnkey mornings.
seeds.habit: Label today’s search: land or polish.

seeds.coreIdea: The public lesson should still work if they never text. The invitation is for a tailored plan, not a trap.
seeds.sourceNote: RITUAL_RULES honesty beat. Fixed CTA required.
seeds.bridgeRule: Give one usable rule. Then the fixed CTA.
seeds.habit: Complete today’s keystone habit even if you do not post.
